title: Changing of the Seasons
content: Reflecting on last month’s editorial, “BioScience, a global biodiversity journal, seeks a globally diverse editorial board” (https://doi.org/10.1093/biosci/biaf163), we realize that a preponderance of our editorial board and readership recognizes that summer is but a memory as the temperate region is beginning to manifest a winter landscape. Gone are the summer bird migrants from as far as the most southern points of Africa and South America, and the complex sounds of a hot August night are chilled. Our orientation may be shifting from the outdoors to the indoors, and toward all the social engagements that occur from November to January. Hopefully, in the future, more of our editorial board will find a discordance with the above and be able to share their wisdom and knowledge of biodiversity from the Southern Hemisphere.
